summary_en: Interim dividend raised from 18¥ to 20¥ per share (+2¥). Annual dividend guidance lifted from 38¥ to 40¥ per share. Rationale: Q1 FY2026 sales and operating profit at record highs year-over-year; solid near-term business momentum and revenue trajectory.
title_en: Notification of Revision to Interim Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: CELSYS announced on 5 June 2026 that its board has revised the interim (half-year) dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending 31 December 2026. The interim dividend per share is raised from 18 yen to 20 yen, an increase of 2 yen. Consequently, the full-year dividend guidance is lifted from 38 yen to 40 yen per share, also a 2-yen increase. The company cites strong Q1 FY2026 results—sales and operating profit both reached record highs on a year-over-year basis—and steady near-term business progress and revenue performance as the rationale. The company regards shareholder returns as a material management priority and aims to maintain stable dividends while achieving medium- and long-term dividend growth, mindful of achieving high ROE whilst preserving financial soundness.
